name: phone_walk
text: A person walks slowly forward at a steady pace while looking down at a phone held in their right hand in front of their chest. Their left arm swings a little and their feet take regular alternating steps. They keep walking without stopping.
pilot: keyframes source = the previously selected phone_walk (4 s, no endpoint constraints; git 10d4ac9), gait cycle frames 27-92 (right heel strike to right heel strike)

review.notes_zh: 循环版（2026-09-25）：从旧 phone_walk 取一个步态周期（27–92 帧）做全身关键帧，生成一个周期（66 帧含重复端点，循环 2.17 秒）。右手稳定在胸前、头向下看，左臂小幅摆动，缓步前进约 0.96 米（0.3–0.8 米/秒）。首尾同姿势、只差前进量，可无缝循环。无手机实体。
